name: GR 5 France
description_md:
The GR 5 France is a waymarked hiking route in France spanning 1613.9 km. It features 66183 m of ascent and 66192 m of descent.

This international waymarked hiking network route takes about 580 hours on the DIN 33466 hiking time rule. The difficulty is hard, derived from distance and ascent. The line matches the official route published by ign_bdtopo. The route passes Nice within 900 m and the musée Marc-Chagall within 1000 m.
